originMethod: Centroid of OpenStreetMap Devon Energy Tower building:part way156035399

footprints.source: City of Oklahoma City / Esri Community Maps contributors

scale.projection: Local equirectangular projection at Devon Tower latitude
scale.ground: Flat local datum; source elevations are not available

nightLighting: Eight non-shadowing point lights at modeled lamp locations illuminate the western approach. More distant lamps use soft ground-only light-pool overlays. Intensities are visual approximations, not a photometric survey.
limits: Geographic footprint/street placement is mapped; supporting heights without tags are estimates.
Road widths are reconstructed from OSM lane counts; turning pockets and traffic signal timing are simplified.
Ground elevation is flattened; this is not a surveyed terrain model.
Landmark crowns and facades are visual reconstructions, not original construction models.
Garden paths follow mapped ways; supplementary park planting is illustrative and not a surveyed tree inventory.
